en-GB.name: Recipus Shopping List
en-GB.summary: Add things to the household's shopping list by voice.
en-GB.description:
Adds items to a self-hosted Recipus shopping list. Say: tell shopping helper to add milk and bread.

This skill is not published. It runs against a private home server and is only usable by the developer account's own devices.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell shopping helper to add milk
Alexa, tell shopping helper to add milk and bread

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private household skill. Endpoint is a self-hosted server behind Nginx Proxy Manager.
